g.text: Buffer circuit for Voltage Adjust, when using the MCU to do PWM instead U406 as DAC

MCP1824 and AP2127 can be used, but have different reference voltages.
MCP1824: Ideal R403/R404/R405 = 77.96K/99.22K/10K Closest values are 78K/100K/10K
AP2127: Ideal R403/R404/R405 = 31.25K/39.77K/10K Closest values are 31.6K/40.2K/10K

Q401 is a matched PNP pair with EBCEBC pinout. BCM857, BCM856, NST45010MW6T1G can be substituted. The BCM part numbers are made by several manufacturers. This part may be substituted in Q601, but it costs significantly more.
DMMT3906, PMP5201, PMP5501 are similar but have a BBCEEC pinout. These can be substituted with minor changes to the PCB.
Q601 is a general purpose dual PNP transistor with EBCEBC pinout. Matched pair Q401 can be substituted here, but Q401 is more expensive.
Small pull-down on VOUT_VREF. Ensures proper partial power down function of the 74LVC1T45
IO expander and logic level translation
U402: Can be 74HC4067 or 74HCT4067 because it is driven by U503 at 5volt logic levels. The HC version is typically much cheaper with better availability.
3 LEDs, 3.2Vf @ 20mA 30R current limiting resistor @ 0.108W R209 minimum size should be 0805
U501/U502: Must be 74HC595 (not HCT) because they run at 3.3volts. U503: Must be 74HCT245 (not HC) because it runs at 5volts and is driven by U501 at 3.3volt logic levels
U309/U310: 74HC4066 or 74HCT4066 may be used. HCT seems cheapest. Operates at 5volts, driven by U503 at 5volt logic levels
Y101: 3225 package is cheapest, smallest, widely available crystal at the moment
J202 is the bog standard, most common Chinese USB C connector.
Worst case power budget is 220mA during full buffer short. Sized for 145mA max, 100mA typical. C402 can be a ceremic capacitor with 0-2ohms ESR
